policy.name: Method and independent contributions
policy.locked_rule: Assign method only when the paper makes a substantive technical or algorithmic contribution. Applying existing methods, assembling standard components, or performing routine experiments without substantive methodological novelty is insufficient.
policy.decision_question: Does the paper introduce an independently identifiable, substantive methodological contribution?

selection.prior_first_pass_check: Reconciled the decision sheet and residual policy ledger against all ten prior Batch C wave manifests after Wave 4D publication. Exactly R117, R376, and R549 are unresolved R4 method cases absent from prior first-pass reviews.
